Gather attested copies of all degree and experience certificates.
Send the hard copy of the application along with attested copies of certificates by speed post to the Principal Investigator.
Send a copy of the application through email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Mention the project number (IIT (ISM) SRDP1410G) on the subject of the application and email.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by IIT (ISM) Dhanbad to hire 1 Project Assistant under a JCSTI sponsored project titled "Design, Synthesis, and Development of Next-Generation Green Cement Composites for Enhanced Geothermal Systems in Jharkhand".

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 18 October 2026 by 11:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B. Sc in Chemistry or Geology with more than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years at the time of appointment, with relaxations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy layer), and female candidates as per GOI/DST rules.
